chosen.chosen: The copyright year is 2026 alone, not a range (LICENSE:3).
chosen.why: The repository's first commit is in 2026, as git log --reverse prints it, and every commit since is in 2026, so a range would have nothing to span.

chosen.chosen: The MIT text's lines are wrapped at under 80 characters, as GitHub's licence template and choosealicense.com give it, rather than the SPDX file's longer lines (LICENSE:5-21).
chosen.why: The checklist judges the words with line breaks aside, so either wrapping keeps the text standard; the shorter wrapping reads without side scrolling in a terminal or an 80-column editor.
